第11885章 收回玄武甲（第1页）
林轩早有打算，语气平淡地吩咐道：“让分身被你们击杀，
分身手中的惊雷剑和玄武甲，你得想办法从战场上要过来，然后暗中还给我。
这两件宝物，我肯定不会让它们落到别人手里。”
这两件宝物，一件是极品神兵，一件是玄武族的镇族之宝，他绝不可能轻易舍弃。
华溪烟心里低咒了一声，心里重新燃起了希望，她才不相信那国师有什么奇门遁甲之术，如今离开，绝对是这间房子有出口。
梁墨菊的眼里闪过一道寒光，黄连会跟她离心，跟刘氏有很多的关系。一开始，黄连虽然不听她的话，执意要去做那禁卫军指挥使，然而他依然还是很敬重她这大姐。在别的方面，还是听她的话，从来就不敢随意落她的面子。
“还没，我在外面应酬。”来来往往的车辆不时的发出喇叭声，季墨就算想骗王依茜也难，所以干脆说自己在外面了。
“你说什么？这是王凯和张凯峰在一起谈话的录音？”刘洋有点不敢置信的问道。
最亮的星……想到这四个字，李后上好的牡丹脂粉掩盖下的面色忽然间苍白起来，就连眼神也由刚才的漫不经心变得慎重无比。
这也是受了信息素的影响吗？我觉得未必。我在密闭的船舱里抱了庄妮三天三夜才让我的信息素生效，而我和班长重逢不到半天，我们露天而眠，现在外面风又这么大，信息素的浓度根本就无法保证。
器破天手提着茶壶向远处走去，只是他刚刚走了没有几步，和风雨的身影就来到了他的身前，拦住了他的去路。
“除去此事，还有你对我和知微感情的质疑，我就容不下你！”半晌，云祁总算是淡淡地开了口。
他突然转移视线，眼神瞬间变得冰冷，距离计划成功越来越近了，顾允蜜是他利用的棋子，所有的人都是棋子。
结果，十五分钟不到，王进忠那张脸就成了紫茄子，说话大着舌头已经找不着调了。
与此同时，四周屋子中陆续有人出来，纷纷围了过来，好奇地打量着王平安一行五人。
至于摇光，她完全不担心，确定了何庸枝是姜十七的人后，她就把大部分的事都交给他去办了，毕竟姜十七身边的人没有太笨的。
还好还好，没出什么大问题，要是宁如杉没了，沈信这种宠妻狂魔还不把自己活剥了皮？

在清平坊的最外面种了两丛翠竹，翠竹旁是一个木门，挂着两个灯笼，照亮了三个字：“清平坊”。
“竟不知天下有如此无耻之人。”苏荩淡声说着，冷漠的瞥着两人。
帝都大学的人看向他，其他有不少人，也看向他，甚至就连那些心怀恶意的人，也都将目光，紧紧看向周易。
于是她有些无奈的道：“盛况，去帮忙，不要让人把大皇子妃杀了就可以了。”她话语里暗含深意。
说完他就一甩袖子提步离开这里，摇光左看看看看，伸出手拍拍自己的脸，这时才发现自己的手心里都是泥土。
这便是唐宝儿的四象诛魔大阵，是目前唐宝儿能够布置出来的最恐怖大阵，只不过布置这样的大阵对唐宝儿的负担也很大，此时唐宝儿的脸色也苍白了起来。
伴随着一阵清风吹过，一道黑影出现在杨尘视线中，正是器山的黑袍长老，他衣衫猎猎，实力不凡。

Chapter 11885 Taking Back the Xuanwu Armor (Page 1)
Lin Xuan had already planned it and ordered in a calm tone: "Let the clone be killed by you.
You have to find a way to get the Thunder Sword and Xuanwu Armor from the battlefield, and then return them to me secretly.
I will definitely not let these two treasures fall into the hands of others. "
These two treasures, one is a top-grade magic weapon, and the other is the treasure of the Xuanwu clan, he will never give up easily.
Hua Xiyan cursed in her heart, and her hope rekindled in her heart. She didn't believe that the national master had any extraordinary skills to escape armor. If she left now, there would definitely be an exit from this house.
A cold light flashed in Liang Moju's eyes. Huang Lian would break up with her and had many connections with the Liu family. Although Huang Lian didn't listen to her at first and insisted on becoming the commander of the Imperial Guard, he still respected her as the eldest sister. In other respects, he still listens to her words and never dares to lose her face at will.
"Not yet, I'm socializing outside." The cars coming and going honked from time to time. Even if Ji Mo wanted to deceive Wang Yiqian, it would be difficult, so he simply said that he was outside.
"What did you say? This is a recording of Wang Kai and Zhang Kaifeng talking together?" Liu Yang asked in disbelief.
The brightest star... Thinking of these four words, Empress Li's complexion, covered by the fine peony powder, suddenly turned pale, and even her eyes changed from the casualness just now to extremely cautious.
Is this also affected by pheromones? I don't think so. It took me three days and three nights to hold Zhuang Ni in the airtight cabin for my pheromones to take effect, and less than half a day after my squad leader and I reunited, we slept in the open air. It was so windy outside that the concentration of the pheromones could not be guaranteed at all.
Qi Potian walked away with the teapot in his hand, but he had just walked a few steps when He Fengyu's figure came in front of him and blocked his way.
"Except for this matter and your doubts about my relationship with Zhiwei, I can't tolerate you!" After a while, Yun Qi finally spoke calmly.
He suddenly shifted his gaze, and his eyes instantly became cold. He was getting closer and closer to the success of the plan. Gu Yunmi was the pawn he used, and everyone was a pawn.
As a result, in less than fifteen minutes, Wang Jinzhong's face turned into a purple eggplant, and he could no longer find the right tone when he spoke loudly.
At the same time, people from the surrounding houses came out one after another and gathered around, looking at Wang Ping'an and the five of them curiously.
As for Fluctlight, she wasn't worried at all. After confirming that He Yongzhi was Jiang Qi's person, she left most of the things to him. After all, no one around Jiang Qi was too stupid.
Fortunately, nothing happened. If Ning Rushan died, wouldn't Shen Xin, a wife-loving maniac like him, skin him alive?
There are two clumps of green bamboo planted on the outermost side of Qingpingfang. Next to the green bamboos is a wooden door with two lanterns hanging on it, illuminating three words: "Qingpingfang".
"I didn't know there were such shameless people in the world." Su Xin said quietly, glancing at the two of them indifferently.
People from Imperial University looked at him, and many others also looked at him. Even those with malicious intentions looked at Zhou Yi closely.
So she said helplessly: "Shengcheng, go and help, just don't let anyone kill the eldest princess." There was a deep meaning in her words.
After saying that, he shook off his sleeves and walked out of here. He looked around, stretched out his hand and patted his face. Only then did he realize that his palms were filled with dirt.
This is Tang Baoer's Four-Elephant Demon-Slaying Formation. It is the most terrifying formation that Tang Baoer can currently arrange. However, setting up such an array puts a great burden on Tang Baoer. At this time, Tang Baoer's expression also changed.He became pale.
As a gust of breeze blew by, a black shadow appeared in Yang Chen's sight. It was the black-robed elder of Qishan. He was dressed like a hunter and had extraordinary strength.
